day.title: Probes, 24 h
day.return: Filter return (the pool while the pump runs)

fill_too_long.content:
## ⚠️ Fill running unusually long
{% set on = states.binary_sensor.pool_controller_fill_running_too_long.last_changed %} The fill has been running for more than **{{ states('number.pool_controller_fill_alarm_after') | int(0) }} min** (alarm at {{ as_local(on).strftime('%H:%M') }}). Check the water supply, the float valve, or for a leak. {% if is_state('binary_sensor.pool_controller_fill_alarm_acknowledged', 'on') %} Alarm **acknowledged**: no more reminders until this fill ends. {% else %} The reminders go on until someone acknowledges it. {% endif %}

override_stuck.content:
## ⚠️ Filtration paused
**Manual Override** has been on **{{ states('select.pool_controller_manual_override') }}** for more than 30 min, with no time limit: the pump no longer follows its plan. Set it back to **Auto**, or give the override a duration (the controller then goes back to Auto by itself).

not_computed.content:
## ⚠️ Today's plan not computed
The controller couldn't read the temperature or the time of sunrise: the pump may stay stopped. Check the probes, then **Recompute the plan**.

force_speed.description: Forces the pool pump to one speed through the controller's Manual Override select. The controller ends the override itself after Manual Override Timeout minutes (0 = never); pass `duree` to set that timeout first.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: The speed to force. In YAML, its value is Off, Low, Medium or High, whatever the language.

duration.name: Duration (min)
duration.description: Minutes before going back to Auto, 0 = never. Empty: the duration already set on the controller.

back_to_auto.description: Hands the pump back to the controller's autonomous plan (Manual Override → Auto).
